responsibility: Declares the internal data structures and enums that model RVV VL/VTYPE requirements for the `vsetvl` pass. It defines AVL tracking, VL/VTYPE state records, demand and fusion classifications, per-instruction and per-block vector-info objects, bitmap-managed expression sets, and the rule-wrapper types used by the pass implementation, making it the analysis interface for vector configuration optimization.
same_name_distinction: Among the `riscv-vsetvl` files, this header declares the analysis model used by the pass, including AVL tracking, VL/VTYPE state classes, demand and fusion enums, block/insn info objects, and rule-wrapper types. Unlike `riscv-vsetvl.cc`, it does not implement the optimization pass, and unlike `riscv-vsetvl.def`, it is not the table of compatibility rules.
